Serbia
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Beograd, Serbia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of the Republic of Serbia are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
NOTE:Holders of UNMIK passports require visa to enter, exit or pass through the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina.BiH Embassies in Skopje, Podgorica and Belgrade are issuing visas on a separate paper to holders of travel documents from Kosovo, for entry, exit or transit through the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
